fit.overlap_check: No duplicate raw SHA-256 or constituent packet timestamps across the 31 recordings; windows overlap within each recording.
fit.transition_exclusion: Lan3/standing first 3.5 s relative to first window target excluded from presence fitting and scoring. Video initially shows background and the subject entering.

matched_video.reference: Camera field of view in the matching Lan2.MOV or Lan3.MOV. Video is exclusively offline. No video labels are transferred to the Ubuntu reference sessions.
matched_video.visual_review: Reviewed every matched target frame in both empty clips and ambiguous observations in the occupied clips. In Lan3/empty MediaPipe returned six visible core joints in 115/190 empty images. All empty clip pose labels are masked.
matched_video.presence_protocol: Both November 5 rounds entirely excluded from the presence fit. Held-out raw end timestamps matched to the same video export. Scores before the three-window display confirmation; occupied scoring restricted to synchronized visible pose, reviewed absence scored within the empty clips.
matched_video.pose_protocol: Two whole-round pose refits. Each uses poses and normalization from the opposite video; presence classifier for each refit excludes the entire November 5 day. Same participant and room. Score visible camera landmarks; a suppressed pose counts as a miss. PCK radius = 0.05 of 1920x1080 diagonal. Side is anatomical. Only camera-visible, separated wrist/shoulder comparisons are scored.
matched_video.limits: Repeated overlapping windows in two same-day recordings. Whole-round refits were compared during algorithm development. Training-round replays describe fit only. Still seated has no synchronized video here. These development folds do not establish field accuracy in a different room.

pose_training_alternative.description: Extra single-arm oversampling and stronger wrist loss evaluated on the two whole-round development folds. It improved left-wrist recall but lost correct standing arm pairs and both-raised-while-moving frames. This alternative was not deployed.

no_video_reference_only.use: Owner-recalled scenarios consulted for debugging and replay behavior only. Included in neither fitted weights nor video accuracy metrics. Latest failed live run was not saved. No fresh hardware capture in this test environment.

integration.browser: Chrome at 390 and 1280 px, Start/Stop over local WebSocket with Intel fixture bytes appended by a substitute recorder; duration control checked for automatic capture and hidden for manual/replay. Physical IAX not exercised.
